key: GARDEVOIR: And so our challenger has made it this far!
en: GARDEVOIR: And so our challenger has made it this far!
ja: サーナイト: さあ、挑戦者はここまでたどり着きました!

key: But can she surmount the final trial!?
en: But can she surmount the final trial!?
ja: だが彼女は最後の試練を乗り越えられるのか!?

key: But can they surmount the final trial!?
en: But can they surmount the final trial!?
ja: だがあの人は最後の試練を乗り越えられるのか!?

key: But can he surmount the final trial!?
en: But can he surmount the final trial!?
ja: だが彼は最後の試練を乗り越えられるのか!?

key: We'll find out now~
en: We'll find out now~
ja: 今すぐ分かるわ～

key: For each piece besides the King, Queen, and Pawns, they become Rook, Knight or Bishop based on their highest stat!
en: For each piece besides the King, Queen, and Pawns, they become Rook, Knight or Bishop based on their highest stat!
ja: キング、クイーン、ポーン以外の駒は　いちばん高い能力に応じて　ルーク、ナイト、ビショップになるの!

key: One man falls to army after army, so all that's left is dust.
en: One man falls to army after army, so all that's left is dust.
ja: ひとりの男が　軍勢のあとの軍勢に倒れ、残るのは ちりだけ。

key: Dust be with you; guide the way.
en: Dust be with you; guide the way.
ja: ちりと共にあれ。道を示せ。

key: Those with high Attack and Special Attack become Bishops!
en: Those with high Attack and Special Attack become Bishops!
ja: こうげきや とくこうが高い駒はビショップに!

key: Those with high defenses become Rooks!
en: Those with high defenses become Rooks!
ja: ぼうぎょが高い駒はルークに!

key: And for those with high speed, they become Knights adept at assassinating Queens!
en: And for those with high speed, they become Knights adept at assassinating Queens!
ja: すばやさが高い駒は　クイーン狩りの名手ナイトに!

key: Promote?
en: Promote?
ja: プロモーションする?

key: GARDEVOIR: Well, well~ Has our hero finished the final trial so soon?
en: GARDEVOIR: Well, well~ Has our hero finished the final trial so soon?
ja: サーナイト: あらあら～ 主人公はもう最後の試練を終えたの?

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh?
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh?
ja: サーナイト: あら?

key: Oh! You are so close!
en: Oh! You are so close!
ja: おしい! あと少しよ!

key: While it's true the King cannot escape check that way...
en: While it's true the King cannot escape check that way...
ja: たしかにキングはその方向へは逃げられないけれど……

key: Look~ The Queen can just take your Bishop, freeing their King and attacking yours at once!
en: Look~ The Queen can just take your Bishop, freeing their King and attacking yours at once!
ja: ほら～ クイーンがビショップを取れば、キングは自由になって　同時にあなたのキングをねらえるわ!

key: That could have been a costly mistake~
en: That could have been a costly mistake~
ja: 高くつく失敗になるところだったわね～

key: ...Well, what a pity.
en: ...Well, what a pity.
ja: ……あら、残念。

key: It seems you've solved it~
en: It seems you've solved it~
ja: 解けてしまったようね～

key: Anyway~ I'll be seeing you again soon, buuuut...
en: Anyway~ I'll be seeing you again soon, buuuut...
ja: ともあれ～ またすぐ会うことになるけど、でもぉ……

key: I mean, my master is the most intelligent, handsome, cunning, elegant and charming man in the world.
en: I mean, my master is the most intelligent, handsome, cunning, elegant and charming man in the world.
ja: だってマスターは　世界でいちばん賢くて　美しくて　したたかで　優雅で　魅力的な人なのよ。

key: Do you really think you can beat him?
en: Do you really think you can beat him?
ja: 本当に勝てると思っているの?

key: Stay tuned to find out~
en: Stay tuned to find out~
ja: 答えはお楽しみに～

key: Well, it looks like you tried, I guess.
en: Well, it looks like you tried, I guess.
ja: まあ、やってはみたようね。

key: But you didn't really think this through, did you?
en: But you didn't really think this through, did you?
ja: でも　よく考えなかったでしょう?

key: Are you sure there's no way that the King can get out of check?
en: Are you sure there's no way that the King can get out of check?
ja: 本当にキングが王手から逃れる手はないの?

key: All I'll say is that you seem to have missed the mark~
en: All I'll say is that you seem to have missed the mark~
ja: 言えるのは、的を外しているみたいってことだけ～

key: Why, it looks like you've made an illegal move.
en: Why, it looks like you've made an illegal move.
ja: あら、反則の手を指したみたいね。

key: Your King is wide open to the enemy attack.
en: Your King is wide open to the enemy attack.
ja: あなたのキングは　敵の攻撃にまる裸よ。

key: In other words, you've moved into check.
en: In other words, you've moved into check.
ja: つまり、自分から王手に飛びこんだの。

key: That's one you'll have to fix~
en: That's one you'll have to fix~
ja: それは直してもらわないとね～

key: GARDEVOIR: Ohh, then don't waste your time with me.
en: GARDEVOIR: Ohh, then don't waste your time with me.
ja: サーナイト: あら、それならわたしに時間を使うことはないわ。

key: I know I'm a star, but-- just this once-- your attention is better served on the challenge.
en: I know I'm a star, but-- just this once-- your attention is better served on the challenge.
ja: 自分がスターなのは分かっているけれど——今回だけは——挑戦に集中したほうがいいわよ。

key: Bishop
en: Bishop
ja: ビショップ

key: Knight
en: Knight
ja: ナイト

key: Rook
en: Rook
ja: ルーク

key: Queen
en: Queen
ja: クイーン

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
